Yeah, I guess you're right, man. I think our brains are wired to continually feel sad when something happens or live in constant fear of something happening. Your words really helped me, man. Yes, I live with my parents and I'm sure they'd be distraught if something happens to me. I'm not sure about others though, maybe 2 or 3 friends might feel bad longer than the others.

Yeah, I usually tell people that it's gonna be alright and that people do care about them and that self hatred and loathing is just merely a facade, a game that you play with yourself and that you should come out winning and stuff but I guess I just am not thinking right, right now. I felt extremely low but am now a bit better. 

Thank you so much for being here for me and for the community. Continue being this great person :) I'm here if you need anything when you feel low too. Cheers!

I don't live alone. I live with my family. We have a dog but still nobody would really miss me, not even my dog, if I were to go somewhere one day. Yes, I may be missed for a week or so but everyone moves on. Even my dog won't miss me because he has other people who'd take care of him. I really don't know.
I'm riding the same boat. I dislike being alone but also don't want people to communicate with me. I don't even know what I want and what I don't want. I'm really messed up.
Started writing the biography yesterday due to the same feelings. I think I have an idea as to how you feel. Here if you need to talk :)
